articles.title: Nepal flood: What we know so far
articles.content: The flood destroyed buildings and structures, sweeping away entire villages. Official figures suggested that more than 1,500 people, including at least 800 foreigners, were among the missing. Nine Singaporeans were also reported missing as at noon on Aug 27.
